# Repository preview images

These files are copied without pixel changes from Gather's own icon and reviewed 1.8.15 QA artifacts. All names, IDs and page content are fictional.

- `gather.svg`: packaged extension icon.
- `lookup.png`: rendered toolbar fixture from the final 1.8.15 suite; real product UI with controlled extension APIs. It is an interface preview, not a live-platform test.
- `image-editor.png`: installed Linux Edge editor test, preserving the screenshot's fictional content.

Images do not establish signed-in Windows or native OS-dialog acceptance. See the release test report for verification scope.
